reviewConclusions.subject: registry-evidence

reviewConclusions.subject: publisher-continuity
reviewConclusions.details: The npm package repositories, maintainers, and provenance workflows match their established Browserslist and electron-to-chromium publishers.

reviewConclusions.subject: upstream-causality
reviewConclusions.details: Browserslist 4.28.8 authorizes both data-package versions through its dependency ranges, and the exact UltraModern release cohort selected them during a clean downstream install.

reviewConclusions.subject: minimum-release-age
reviewConclusions.details: Approve only these two exact versions until the later artifact reaches the configured 24-hour minimum age. HTTPS, integrity, provenance, and dependency-closure validation remain mandatory.
